title: Markup in a name does not run
summary: Submit a script-like name and assert it is shown as text, not executed.
description: A XSS check on the signup form: type a name that looks like HTML, submit, and expect the string to appear as text. Playwright and Cypress both assert that window.__xss stays unset and that #success contains no extra img.
architecture: The SUT writes the name with textContent (not innerHTML). The test is a user path plus a security oracle: if the page had assigned innerHTML, the onerror handler would set window.__xss. Failures point at unsafe DOM writes, not at a missing required-field message.
